mapper.select: SELECT partenName , deptName , SUM(hxkt) AS hxkt, SUM(zxktxj) AS zxktxj, SUM(zxktxjys) AS zxktxjys, SUM(cgzh) AS cgzh, SUM(xslw) AS xslw, SUM(jczz) AS jczz, SUM(zlrz) AS zlrz, SUM(jl) AS jl, SUM(jzbg) AS jzbg FROM Alltotle_score where partenId = #{parentId} GROUP BY deptName,partenName
